answer: Grove graft: each identity plants an ivory seed in the grove, and grafting a clone onto the same root costs 50 times the square of its graft number: graft one costs 50, graft two 200, graft three 450, so ten grafts pay 19,250 and a hundred pay 16,917,500. A velvet rope admits one new graft per root per day, so a hundred fakes wait a hundred days and pay 16,917,500 to enter.
